title: Melrose Abbey

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Corporate parties, quinceañeras, cultural celebrations, galas and shoots - in a restored 1922 church with a 35-foot dome, for up to 200 guests. Yes. Melrose Abbey hosts corporate and non-profit events, holiday parties, quinceañeras and sweet sixteens, engagement and cultural celebrations, fundraisers and galas, milestone birthdays and anniversaries, and photo and film shoots. The building is a 1922 Gothic church in midtown Kansas City with a 35-foot suspended domed ceiling, original stained glass, two event floors and a balcony, and it holds up to 200 guests. The full building is $3,750 Monday through Thursday - the same 14 hours, 9am to 11pm, and the same two floors a wedding gets. Friday
